bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to veterans; appropriating money for a grant to Veterans on the Lake.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+VETERANS ON THE LAKE; GRANT; APPROPRIATION. +]

[+$200,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of veterans affairs for a grant to Veterans on the Lake to fund repairs of a septic system at a facility that serves disabled veterans in Ely. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to veterans; appropriating money for a grant to Veterans on the Lake.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. VETERANS ON THE LAKE; GRANT; APPROPRIATION.

$200,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of veterans affairs for a grant to Veterans on the Lake to fund repairs of a septic system at a facility that serves disabled veterans in Ely.
additions: VETERANS ON THE LAKE; GRANT; APPROPRIATION.
